environment.description: Kubernetes pod running migration job on EKS cluster. Pod uses a static ServiceAccount with long-lived database credentials injected via environment variables from a Kubernetes Secret (type Opaque). The /tmp directory is backed by the node's ephemeral storage (emptyDir not used; hostPath /tmp is shared). No PodSecurityPolicy or SecurityContext restrictions. Other pods on the same node can read /tmp via hostPID: true or shared volume mounts. Credentials in the Kubernetes Secret are rotated manually (quarterly). SIGTERM sent by Kubernetes during pod eviction leaves the credentials file in /tmp for the duration of the graceful termination period (30s default).
